test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K _ C T Q _ O C _ _ K O _ T _ K O _ T T

options.text: O, K, T, R, C, S, C
O, K, U, R, C, S, C
P, K, T, R, C, S, C
O, K, T, R, C, T, C

solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**From option 1:-**

K **O** C T Q / **K** O C **T R** / K O **C** T **S /** K O **C** T T → follows a pattern.

**Here K O C T remains the same but the last letter increased by 1 in each group.**

From option 2:-

K O C T Q / K O C U R / K O C T S / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

From option 3:-

K P C T Q / K O C T R / K O C T S / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

From option 4:-

K O C T Q / K O C T R / K O C T T / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
